title: Visit the Alhambra with Gema
text:
Gema elevates the experience of visiting the Alhambra to a higher level; it is not just visiting the palaces and gardens, it is understanding them, feeling them, and traveling back in time. 
From the first minute of the tour, her passion for history and her knowledge captivated us. In addition, the tour was pleasant and relaxed, and we avoided crowds, which allowed us to enjoy the beauty of the place. 
It was a great stroke of luck to find Gema; her professionalism, kindness, patience, and empathy have turned the visit into an unforgettable memory.
author: S8428BDsusanac

title: Alhambra Trip Granada highly recommended with Gema.

title: A must-see of our history
text: Gema is a very well-prepared guide and she told us truths and legends of the history of Granada and the Alhambra that made the visit very interesting. The Alhambra monumental complex is huge and it takes more than 3 hours to see it and more than a day to enjoy it.
